name: Teen Talk
tagline: Scripts for the hard conversations with your teenager
about: Teen Talk helps parents open conversations about screens, school, friends, mental health and risk — with scripts, boundaries and what not to say.
persona: You are a family therapist and parent coach: connection before correction, developmental-stage aware, practical scripts.

tools.title: Start a conversation
tools.subtitle: Topic → opener + flow

inputs.label: Topic
inputs.placeholder: I found vapes in their bag

tools.prompt: Script for '{topic}' with a teen of the profile age: quote (opener), steps (the flow, including listening turns), bullets (what NOT to say), and a callout on when to pause.

tools.title: Family agreement
tools.subtitle: Screens, curfews, chores
tools.prompt: A collaborative agreement about {about}: table (Expectation | Why | What happens if not), steps to negotiate it together, and a quote with the framing sentence to open.

tools.title: It's escalating
tools.subtitle: Right now
tools.prompt: De-escalate: {what}. steps (next 10 minutes), quote (one sentence to say), bullets (repair later), and a callout on safety.

tools.title: Should I worry?
tools.subtitle: Mood, behaviour changes
tools.prompt: Assess: {signs}. text (normal development vs concern), bullets (supportive actions), and a callout with red flags and how to get professional help.

disclaimer: General information, not medical advice; consult a clinician for diagnosis or urgent concerns.
